cc:Work.dc:description: Replot of an existing independent public-source S2 simulation, not a new solve. Panel A: every scan value on its original grid, without interpolation. Panel B: exact x=-0.7 and +0.7 micrometre scan columns; grey bands mark cross arms. Both panels use the same full-S2-map peak 3.2356892685644277e-12 A. The source strength is arbitrary, without experimental amplitude calibration. Source CSV SHA256: 569387688e98b0489d572bfa1785139d193e511e9793ca05f0a23712cec69ff5. Reference DOI: 10.1038/s41565-018-0323-8.
